```{r}
library(terra)
library(blockCV)

source(here::here("3-scripts", "1-functions.r"))

do_rast <- rast(readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "ipdw_do.rds")))
sal_rast <- rast(readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "ipdw_sal.rds")))
turb_rast <- rast(readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "ipdw_turb.rds")))
water_temp_rast <- rast(readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "ipdw_water_temp.rds")))
depth_rast <- rast(here::here("2-data", "processed", "depth_rast.rds"))
sed_rast <- rast(here::here("2-data", "processed", "sed_rast.rds"))
occ <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "oyster_pts_0903.rds" ))

target_crs <- "ESRI:103021"
```


```{r}
do_rast <- resample(
  do_rast,
  depth_rast,
  method = "bilinear"
)

sal_rast <- resample(
  sal_rast,
  depth_rast,
  method = "bilinear"
)

turb_rast <- resample(
  turb_rast,
  depth_rast,
  method = "bilinear"
)

water_temp_rast <- resample(
  water_temp_rast,
  depth_rast,
  method = "bilinear"
)

occ <- sf::st_transform(
  occ,
  "ESRI:103021"
)

occ_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(occ)
```

```{r}

# Convert terra predictors to raster::RasterStack
predictors_raster <- raster::stack(
  raster::raster(do_rast),
  raster::raster(sal_rast),
  raster::raster(turb_rast),
  raster::raster(water_temp_rast),
  raster::raster(depth_rast),
  raster::raster(sed_rast)
)

names(predictors_raster) <- c(
  "dissolved_oxygen",
  "salinity",
  "turbidity",
  "water_temperature",
  "depth",
  "sediment"
)

```

```{r}
# create mask to  background points
mask_terra <- rast(predictors_raster[[1]])

# Rasterize study area polygon
mask_terra <- rasterize(
  vect(study_area),
  mask_terra,
  field = 1,
  background = NA
)

# Convert for dismo
mask <- raster::raster(mask_terra)
crs(mask) = target_crs

set.seed(42)

bg <- dismo::randomPoints(
  mask = mask,
  n = 5000,
  p = occ_xy,
  excludep = TRUE
)

plot(bg)

```

```{r}

occ_cv <- data.frame(
  x = occ_xy[, 1],
  y = occ_xy[, 2],
  pb = 1
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = target_crs
  )

bg_cv <- data.frame(
  x = bg[, 1],
  y = bg[, 2],
  pb = 0
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = target_crs
  )

cv_pts <- rbind(
  occ_cv,
  bg_cv
)
```

# Determine Spatial Auto Correlation to determine fold size
```{r}
continuous_predictors <- c(
  do_rast,
  sal_rast,
  turb_rast,
  water_temp_rast,
  depth_rast
)

names(continuous_predictors) <- c(
  "dissolved_oxygen",
  "salinity",
  "turbidity",
  "water_temperature",
  "depth"
)

spat_corr <- cv_spatial_autocor(
  r = continuous_predictors,
  num_sample = 5000,
  plot = TRUE,
  progress = TRUE
)

occ_sac <- blockCV::cv_spatial_autocor(
  x = cv_pts,
  column = "pb",
  plot = TRUE,
  progress = TRUE
)

occ_sac$range
occ_sac$range_table

```

```{r}
block_sizes <- c(2500, 5000, 7500, 10000, 12500)


# Create folds
spatial_folds <- purrr::map(
  block_sizes,
  ~blockCV::cv_spatial(
    x = cv_pts,
    column = "pb",
    r = rast(mask),
    k = 5,
    size = .x, 
    selection = "random",
    iteration = 1000,
    balance = TRUE,
    presence_bg = TRUE,
    seed = 42,
    progress = TRUE,
    report = TRUE,
    plot = TRUE
  )
)

spatial_folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = cv_pts,
  column = "pb",
  r = rast(mask),
  k = 5,
  size = 5000,
  selection = "random",
  iteration = 1000,
  balance = TRUE,
  presence_bg = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  progress = TRUE,
  report = TRUE,
  plot = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
folds <- spatial_folds$folds_list

cv_models <- vector("list", length(folds))
cv_evals  <- vector("list", length(folds))
cv_results <- vector("list", length(folds))

for (i in seq_along(folds)) {

  train_idx <- folds[[i]][[1]]
  test_idx  <- folds[[i]][[2]]

  train_sf <- cv_pts[train_idx, ]
  test_sf  <- cv_pts[test_idx, ]

  p_train <- sf::st_coordinates(
    train_sf[train_sf$pb == 1, ]
  )

  a_train <- sf::st_coordinates(
    train_sf[train_sf$pb == 0, ]
  )

  p_test <- sf::st_coordinates(
    test_sf[test_sf$pb == 1, ]
  )

  a_test <- sf::st_coordinates(
    test_sf[test_sf$pb == 0, ]
  )

  m <- dismo::maxent(
    x = predictors_raster,
    p = p_train,
    a = a_train,
    factors = "sediment",
    removeDuplicates = FALSE
  )

  e <- dismo::evaluate(
    p = p_test,
    a = a_test,
    model = m,
    x = predictors_raster
  )

  cv_models[[i]] <- m
  cv_evals[[i]] <- e

  cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    fold = i,
    train_presence = nrow(p_train),
    test_presence = nrow(p_test),
    train_background = nrow(a_train),
    test_background = nrow(a_test),
    auc = e@auc
  )
}

cv_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(cv_results)
cv_results

```

```{r}
cv_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cv_results
)

cv_results

cv_summary <- cv_results %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_auc = mean(auc),
    sd_auc = sd(auc),
    min_auc = min(auc),
    max_auc = max(auc)
  )

cv_summary

```

```{r}

final_model <- dismo::maxent(
  x = predictors_raster,
  p = occ_xy,
  a = bg,
  factors = "sediment",
  removeDuplicates = FALSE
)

```

```{r}

suitability <- raster::predict(
  final_model,
  predictors_raster
)

suitability <- rast(
  suitability
)

crs(suitability) <- target_crs

names(suitability) <- "maxent_suitability"
```


```{r}

# plot showing importance of each variable
plot(me)

# response curves
response(me)

# predict to entire dataset
r <- predict(me, predictors_raster) 

#testing
# background data
bg <- randomPoints(predictors_raster, 10000)

#simplest way to use 'evaluate'
e1 <- evaluate(me, p=occtest, a=bg, x=predictors_raster)

# alternative 1
# extract values
pvtest <- data.frame(extract(predictors_raster, occtest))
avtest <- data.frame(extract(predictors_raster, bg))

e2 <- evaluate(me, p=pvtest, a=avtest)
e2

# alternative 2 
# predict to testing points 
testp <- predict(me, pvtest) 
head(testp)
testa <- predict(me, avtest) 

e3 <- evaluate(p=testp, a=testa)
e3
threshold(e3)

plot(e3, 'ROC')

crs(pred) <- "ESRI:103021"
crs(r) <- "ESRI:103021"


```

```{r}

suitability <- rast(r)

tmap_mode("plot")

suitability_map <-
  tm_shape(suitability) +
  tm_raster(
    col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(
      values = "viridis",
      limits = c(0, 1)

      title = "Suitability"

  ) +
  tm_shape(occ) +
  tm_dots(
    fill = "black",
    size = 0.05
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    frame = FALSE
  ) +
  tm_title(
    "Eastern Oyster Habitat Suitability"
  )

suitability_map
```
